game.title: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered

roadmap.title: Original story and chapter-order collection route
roadmap.description: Finish the story on Very Light while following the 286-location route, completing the three chapter-specific challenges, visiting all ten Downtown locations, crafting each item type, and spending parts and supplements as they become available.

roadmap.title: New Game Plus upgrades and difficulty completions
roadmap.description: Continue the completed save into New Game+ for the remaining parts and supplements. Finish Grounded with Per Chapter Permadeath enabled to combine both completion achievements, then use Chapter Select only for collectible or situational cleanup.

roadmap.title: Chronological story completion
roadmap.description: Select the patched Chronological narrative and finish the reordered story from beginning to ending. Use Very Light and accessibility options if the earlier Grounded run supplied enough challenge.

roadmap.title: No Return setup, characters, bosses, and tracks
roadmap.description: Play nine quick setup runs to unlock Gambits, Holdout, Capture, and Daily Run. Unlock the original character lines, win with all ten original characters, clear every boss and faction track, complete every Mod, and finish the Bill and Marlene goals.

roadmap.title: Daily Run wins
roadmap.description: Win a Daily Run on Very Light for practice, then plan a favorable daily board and win the full run on Grounded with accessibility options enabled.

achievements.description: Collect all the regular story achievements
achievements.estTime: after the other 25 regular story achievements
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 25 regular story achievements; Grounded, Permadeath, No Return, and Chronological achievements are not required.

guide.context: This meta-achievement uses the original story set, so title-update achievements do not delay the unlock.

steps.text: Finish the original-order story and complete every collectible, upgrade, crafting, Downtown, and chapter-specific achievement in the regular set.
Confirm that the other @mechanic{25 regular story achievements} are unlocked, then return to gameplay or the main menu so Steam can award the meta-achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the story
achievements.summary: Finish the complete original-order story on any difficulty and reach the ending.

guide.context: Very Light difficulty and combat, navigation, or traversal accessibility options remain eligible.

steps.text: Choose the standard @loc{Story} from the main menu and select any difficulty.
Finish every chapter through @loc{The Farm — Epilogue} and remain in the game until the ending completes.

achievements.description: Learn all player upgrades
achievements.summary: Learn every skill in all ten upgrade trees for Ellie and Abby on one continuous save.

guide.context: The full set costs @item{1,900 supplements}. Two trees unlock through the story and eight come from training manuals, but one playthrough does not supply enough supplements.

steps.text: Collect eight @item{training manuals} during the story so Ellie and Abby have all ten skill trees available.
Open the backpack's skill-tree screen whenever supplements are available and purchase every reachable node during the first playthrough.
Start @mechanic{New Game+} from the completed save and keep collecting supplements without skipping chapters.
Purchase the remaining nodes until every Ellie and Abby tree is fully learned on the same continuous save.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade all weapons
achievements.summary: Fully purchase every upgrade for all 12 campaign weapons on one continuous save.

guide.context: All weapon upgrades cost @item{1,920 parts}. A first playthrough provides only about 80% of that total, and Chapter Select cannot merge upgrade progress.

steps.text: Acquire all six Ellie weapons and all six Abby weapons during the first story run.
At each @mechanic{workbench}, spend parts on late-game weapons first because early weapons return sooner in New Game+.
Start @mechanic{New Game+} from the completed save and continue through chapters in order while collecting parts.
Use workbenches to buy every remaining upgrade node for all 12 weapons on that save.

achievements.description: Find all artifacts and journal entries
achievements.summary: Register all 127 artifacts and all 20 journal entries across the story.

guide.context: Collectibles register to the profile immediately. Chapter Select displays subchapter counters, and loading the furthest-progress save restores chapters hidden by an earlier replay.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Options > HUD > Notifications > Collectible Tracking} so previously registered pickups display a check mark.
During the chapter-order route, pick up every named artifact and activate every journal sketch prompt until the totals reach @item{127 artifacts} and @item{20 journal entries}.
After finishing the story, open @mechanic{Chapter Select} and identify every subchapter whose artifact or journal counter is incomplete.
Replay each incomplete subchapter, collect the missing entry, then load the furthest-progress save and return to the main menu to refresh the counters.

achievements.description: Find all trading cards
achievements.summary: Collect all 48 of Ellie's trading cards, ending with Sparkthug in Santa Barbara's Resort.

guide.context: Trading-card credit persists immediately across saves and Chapter Select replays.

steps.text: Follow the chapter-order route through every Ellie subchapter and collect each trading card until the tracker reaches @item{47 of 48}.
In @loc{Santa Barbara — The Resort}, enter the building after the chained garden Runner and take @item{Sparkthug} from the small table immediately right of the doorway.
If the achievement remains locked, use @mechanic{Chapter Select} to find an incomplete trading-card counter and collect the omitted card.

achievements.description: Find all coins
achievements.summary: Collect all 32 of Abby's coins, ending with Arkansas in Seattle Day 3's Escape.

guide.context: Coin credit persists immediately across saves and Chapter Select replays.

steps.text: Follow the chapter-order route through every Abby subchapter and collect each coin until the tracker reaches @item{31 of 32}.
In @loc{Seattle Day 3 — The Escape}, leave the first small store and turn left before crawling under the @loc{Harst Brewer} truck; take @item{Arkansas} from behind the shopping cart.
If the achievement remains locked, use @mechanic{Chapter Select} to find an incomplete coin counter and collect the omitted coin.

achievements.description: Find all workbenches
achievements.summary: Find all 25 campaign workbenches, including the final garden-shack bench in Santa Barbara's Resort.

guide.context: Workbenches are tracked by subchapter, so a missed bench can be recovered without replaying the full story.

steps.text: Approach every @mechanic{workbench} on the chapter-order route until the tracker reaches @mechanic{24 of 25}.
In @loc{Santa Barbara — The Resort}, clear the garden Rattlers and go inside the garden shack positioned beside the chained Runner to register the final workbench.
Use @mechanic{Chapter Select} to find any incomplete workbench counter and approach the missing bench.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a weapon
achievements.estTime: after accumulating parts for one weapon
achievements.summary: Buy every available upgrade node for one weapon at campaign workbenches.

guide.context: Each upgrade consumes parts, and later weapons generally require more parts than the early pistols.

steps.text: Choose one early weapon and reserve enough @item{parts} to finish that weapon before spreading purchases across the arsenal.
At @mechanic{workbenches}, select the chosen weapon and purchase every displayed upgrade node.
Exit the workbench after the final node is installed so the fully upgraded weapon registers.

achievements.description: Learn all player upgrades in one branch
achievements.estTime: after accumulating supplements for one branch
achievements.summary: Purchase every skill in one complete Ellie or Abby upgrade branch.

guide.context: A branch must be completed on one continuous save; Chapter Select cannot combine supplement spending from separate states.

steps.text: Open the backpack's skill-tree screen and choose one unlocked branch with affordable remaining nodes.
Collect supplements and purchase every node in that same branch until the branch displays as complete.

achievements.description: Unlock every safe
achievements.summary: Enter the correct fixed code and open all 14 campaign safes.

guide.context: Safe counters are shown by subchapter, and opening a safe registers immediately even if the chapter is not finished.

steps.text: Follow the chapter-order route, read the nearby code clue for each @item{safe}, enter the fixed combination, and open all 14 safe doors.
After the story, inspect @mechanic{Chapter Select} for any subchapter with an incomplete safe counter.
Replay each incomplete subchapter and open its omitted safe, then return to the main menu after the counter updates.

achievements.description: Visit every location in downtown Seattle
achievements.summary: Mark all ten explorable Downtown Seattle locations on Ellie's map during Seattle Day 1.

guide.context: The achievement can fail to register after all map marks appear. Repeating the route in the listed order through Chapter Select or New Game+ is the documented recovery.

steps.text: In @loc{The Gate}, take the @item{Map of Seattle} from the drawer inside the construction trailer beside the overgrown highway.
In @loc{Downtown}, begin at @loc{Westlake Bank}, cross to @loc{Ruins}, continue into @loc{Valiant Music Shop}, and then mark @loc{Dome}, @loc{Military Tent}, and @loc{Gate West 2}.
Enter @loc{Ruston Coffee}, take the @item{Barko's key} from the restroom, and use the key to enter @loc{Barko's Pet Store}.
Visit @loc{Waterfalls}, then enter @loc{Courthouse} through its window so all ten locations are circled on the map.
If the achievement does not unlock, replay Downtown and revisit the ten locations in the same order.

achievements.description: Find all training manuals
achievements.summary: Find eight training manuals so all ten Ellie and Abby skill trees become available.

guide.context: Two skill trees unlock automatically. Missed manuals reappear at alternate later locations, so the achievement is not permanently missable.

steps.text: Search the documented manual locations during each Ellie and Abby chapter and pick up every @item{training manual} encountered.
Open the backpack's skill-tree screen and confirm that the two story trees plus eight manual trees are visible.
If fewer than ten trees appear, continue searching later subchapters for an alternate spawn of the missed manual.

achievements.description: Learn 25 player upgrades
achievements.summary: Purchase any 25 player-upgrade skills across Ellie and Abby on one continuous save.

guide.context: Supplements are shared only within the current continuous progression; separate Chapter Select states do not combine purchases.

steps.text: Search rooms, containers, and collectible-route side areas for @item{supplements} during both characters' chapters.
Open the backpack's skill-tree screen and purchase upgrade nodes until the cumulative total reaches @mechanic{25 learned skills}.

achievements.description: Find all weapons
achievements.summary: Obtain all 12 campaign weapons: six for Ellie and six for Abby.

guide.context: Several weapons arrive automatically, while route pickups must be collected before their chapters end; Chapter Select can recover omissions.

steps.text: Follow the chapter-order collectible route and pick up every optional weapon for Ellie and Abby while allowing the story-granted weapons to register.
In @loc{Santa Barbara — The Resort}, finish the opening cutscene and receive Ellie's @item{Silenced Submachine Gun} automatically.
If the total remains below @mechanic{12 weapons}, use Chapter Select to replay the subchapter containing the omitted optional weapon.

achievements.description: Find 12 workbenches
achievements.summary: Reach 12 distinct workbenches during the campaign.

guide.context: Workbench credit is cumulative and tracked by subchapter; purchasing an upgrade is not required for this milestone.

steps.text: Follow the chapter-order route and approach each @mechanic{workbench} until the cumulative tracker reaches @mechanic{12 workbenches}.

achievements.description: Craft every item
achievements.summary: Craft each of the 12 campaign item types at least once after unlocking every required recipe.

guide.context: Recipes come from story events, weapon pickups, and player skills. Very Light supplies more crafting materials and reduces cleanup time.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Health Kit}, @item{Molotov}, @item{Stun or Smoke Bomb}, @item{Trap Mine}, @item{Silencer}, and @item{Melee Upgrade} after their recipes unlock.
After obtaining Ellie's Bow and relevant skills, craft @item{Arrows} and @item{Explosive Arrows}.
After Abby reaches @loc{On Foot}, craft a @item{Pipe Bomb}.
Unlock Abby's Firearms skills and craft @item{Incendiary Shells} plus @item{Hunting Pistol Ammo}.
Unlock Abby's Covert Ops tree, purchase @mechanic{Craft Shivs}, and craft one @item{Shiv} to complete the 12-type list.

achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon
achievements.summary: Spend parts on any one weapon-upgrade node at a campaign workbench.

guide.context: Parts are found in rooms, containers, and side areas throughout the collectible route.

steps.text: Collect enough @item{parts} to afford one available weapon-upgrade node.
Use a @mechanic{workbench}, select a weapon, purchase one upgrade node, and exit the workbench after installation.

achievements.description: Learn a player upgrade
achievements.summary: Spend supplements to learn any one Ellie or Abby player-upgrade skill.

guide.context: The backpack displays the supplement cost beside each available node.

steps.text: Collect enough @item{supplements} to afford one node in an unlocked skill tree.
Open the backpack's skill-tree screen and purchase any available player-upgrade node.

achievements.description: Find 5 trading cards
achievements.summary: Collect any five of Ellie's trading cards during the early campaign.

guide.context: Trading-card pickups register immediately and are tracked by subchapter.

steps.text: Follow Ellie's chapter-order route and pick up the first five @item{trading cards} until the cumulative tracker reaches five.

achievements.description: Find 5 coins
achievements.summary: Collect any five of Abby's coins during her early chapters.

guide.context: Coin pickups register immediately and are tracked by subchapter.

steps.text: Follow Abby's chapter-order route and pick up the first five @item{coins} until the cumulative tracker reaches five.

achievements.description: Put a hat on your companion
achievements.summary: Place the Wyoming Museum hat on two dinosaur skeletons, then place the hat on Joel during The Birthday Gift.

guide.context: The sequence can be replayed through Chapter Select if the final Joel prompt is missed.

steps.text: In @loc{The Birthday Gift}, enter the @loc{Wyoming Museum}, turn right into the gift shop, and remove the @item{hat} displayed on a hook.
In the next exhibition hall, place the hat on the first dinosaur skeleton on the left and the first dinosaur skeleton on the right.
Approach @npc{Joel} after both dinosaur interactions and use the displayed prompt to place the hat on him.

achievements.description: Win the marksmanship competition
achievements.summary: Score more than 85 points in Abby's Stadium marksmanship competition before boarding the truck.

guide.context: Lock-On Aim remains eligible and can stabilize fast target acquisition.

steps.text: In @loc{The Stadium}, collect the @item{Semi-Auto Rifle} from the armory.
Before boarding the truck that ends the chapter, enter the shooting range on the right and start the competition.
Hit the red body and head markers repeatedly until the final score exceeds @mechanic{85 points}.

achievements.description: Earn the high score in the archery game
achievements.summary: Hit more than ten Aquarium archery targets before time expires during Winter Visit.

guide.context: The targets may be shot from close range, and Lock-On Aim remains eligible.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Winter Visit}, find the purple @item{bow} on the left side of the Aquarium's first room and start the minigame.
Move through the room and hit at least @mechanic{11 targets} before the timer expires.

achievements.description: Find the Strange Artifact
achievements.summary: Collect the Strange Artifact from the upper Chinatown room in Hostile Territory.

guide.context: The artifact is a Jak and Daxter reference and also contributes to the campaign artifact total.

steps.text: In @loc{Hostile Territory}, reach Chinatown and use the doorway of the final shop along the left side.
Go upstairs, kill the two @enemy{Clickers}, and jump from the shop to the balcony across the street.
Turn left into the upper room whose floor is broken open, then collect the @item{Strange Artifact} from the right side of that opening before dropping down.

achievements.description: Find the Engraved Ring
achievements.summary: Open Westlake Bank's vault with code 60-23-06 and take the Engraved Ring from a rear deposit box.

guide.context: The ring is inside one of Downtown's ten Sightseer locations and also contributes to the artifact total.

steps.text: In @loc{Downtown}, enter @loc{Westlake Bank} and clear the infected from the interior.
Enter @mechanic{60-23-06} on the vault keypad and open the vault door.
At the back of the vault, inspect the rightmost corner and open the deposit box containing the @item{Engraved Ring}.

achievements.description: Complete the story on Grounded.
achievements.summary: Finish the complete story on Grounded difficulty and reach the ending.

guide.context: New Game+ carries upgrades and weapons into the run. Accessibility options remain eligible, and Per Chapter Permadeath may be enabled simultaneously.

steps.text: From the completed story save, start @mechanic{New Game+} and select @mechanic{Grounded} difficulty.
Enable any needed accessibility options before difficult encounters; these settings do not block the achievement.
Complete every story chapter on Grounded and remain in the game until the ending finishes.

achievements.description: Complete the story with any Permadeath setting
achievements.summary: Finish the complete story with the Per Chapter Permadeath setting enabled.

guide.context: Permadeath accepts any combat difficulty. Per Chapter loses the least progress after a death and can be combined with a Grounded completion.

steps.text: Start a new story or New Game+ run and choose @mechanic{Permadeath > Per Chapter}.
Choose any combat difficulty, or choose Grounded to pursue the Grounded completion during the same run.
Complete every chapter without disabling Permadeath and remain in the game until the ending finishes.

achievements.description: Get kills with 5 different weapons in an Assault encounter in No Return
achievements.summary: Score kills with five different weapon types during one No Return Assault encounter.

guide.context: Distinct enemy-dropped melee types count separately from equipped firearms, which reduces the number of guns required.

steps.text: Choose an @mechanic{Assault} node with enough enemies and begin the encounter on a comfortable difficulty.
Kill enemies with several different equipped firearms while keeping a written count of distinct weapon types.
Pick up distinct melee weapons such as a machete, bat, axe, plank, or hammer and earn additional kills until five weapon types have registered in that single encounter.

achievements.description: Kill 12 enemies in a Hunted encounter in No Return
achievements.summary: Kill 12 enemies before the timer expires during one No Return Hunted encounter.

guide.context: A small map with Infected is preferable because Infected rush the player instead of remaining behind cover. Abby heals through melee attacks.

steps.text: Choose a small-map @mechanic{Hunted} encounter with @enemy{Infected} and set the difficulty to Very Light.
Play as @npc{Abby}, move toward each incoming wave, and use fast melee kills while her melee-heal trait offsets damage.
Kill @mechanic{12 enemies} before the single encounter's timer expires.

achievements.description: Win a round of Holdout without your ally falling below 70% health in No Return
achievements.summary: Win one No Return Holdout encounter without the allied NPC's health falling below 70%.

guide.context: Holdout becomes available through @mechanic{Challenges > Core} after five runs; failed runs still advance that unlock counter.

steps.text: Start five No Return runs, allowing quick first-encounter deaths if necessary, until @mechanic{Holdout} unlocks.
Choose a Holdout encounter on Very Light and enter with full ammunition plus crowd-control explosives.
Stay beside the allied NPC and eliminate every Infected wave before the ally's health falls below @mechanic{70%}.
Defeat the final wave while the ally remains at or above 70% health.

achievements.description: Open the safe in Capture without killing any enemies in No Return
achievements.summary: Open the guarded safe during one No Return Capture encounter without killing any enemy.

guide.context: Capture becomes available through @mechanic{Challenges > Core} after seven runs; failed runs still advance that unlock counter.

steps.text: Start seven No Return runs, allowing quick first-encounter deaths if necessary, until @mechanic{Capture} unlocks.
Select a Capture encounter and inspect enemy patrols before leaving cover.
Reach the guarded @item{safe} using stealth without killing any enemy.
Open the safe before the encounter timer expires while the kill count remains zero.

achievements.description: Win a run with every character in No Return
achievements.summary: Win a complete No Return run, including its boss, with Ellie, Dina, Jesse, Tommy, Joel, Abby, Lev, Yara, Mel, and Manny; Bill and Marlene are excluded.

guide.context: Custom Runs count, but the game does not provide a completed-character checklist. Bill and Marlene belong to the later Part I track rather than the original ten-character requirement.

steps.text: Complete 2 encounters as Ellie, 3 as Dina, 3 as Jesse, and 4 as Tommy to unlock Dina, Jesse, Tommy, and Joel in sequence.
Complete 2 encounters as Abby, 3 as Lev, 3 as Yara, and 4 as Mel to unlock Lev, Yara, Mel, and Manny in sequence.

For an optional fast setup, create a Custom Run with @mechanic{Very Light}, @mechanic{Mechanics > Capture only}, @mechanic{Enemies > Seraphites only}, @mechanic{Boss > Arcade Bloater}, and every Mod disabled.
Win one full run including the boss as Ellie, Dina, Jesse, Tommy, Joel, Abby, Lev, Yara, Mel, and Manny; record each completed character manually.

achievements.description: Complete an encounter with each Mod in No Return
achievements.summary: Successfully finish one No Return encounter with each of the 26 original Mods.

guide.context: The trophy tracker shows only a total, not the missing Mod names. All Mod types become available after 12 completed Mod encounters, and Custom Runs count.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{12 Mod encounters} so the full original pool of 26 Mods becomes available.
Write down every Mod shown beneath @mechanic{MODS} on the encounter board and mark each name only after winning that encounter.
Create Custom Runs that enable only uncompleted Mods and finish encounters until the tracker reaches @mechanic{26 of 26}.
If the counter remains at 25 of 26, complete a @mechanic{Mystery Encounter} carrying additional active Mods.

achievements.description: Complete five gambits in one run of No Return
achievements.summary: Complete five displayed Gambits before the boss during one No Return run.

guide.context: More Gambit varieties become available as the lifetime total rises; all are unlocked after 15 completed Gambits.

steps.text: Complete Gambits across early runs until @mechanic{Challenges > Gambits} shows the full pool unlocked.
During a fresh run, read the Gambit displayed at the upper left at the start of every encounter.
Perform the literal displayed condition in five encounters before entering the final boss fight.

achievements.description: Beat all bosses
achievements.summary: Defeat all six No Return bosses across successful runs.

guide.context: The first six bosses unlock in a fixed order, so this goal can be combined with the ten character-run wins.

steps.text: Finish successful No Return runs and defeat each newly unlocked boss at the final encounter.
Defeat @enemy{Arcade Bloater} first, @enemy{Theater Infestation} second, @enemy{Rattler Captain} third, @enemy{Garage Bloater} fourth, @enemy{Seraphite Elite} fifth, and @enemy{Rat King} sixth.

achievements.description: Complete all Ellie faction challenge tracks
achievements.summary: Complete every No Return challenge track for Ellie, Dina, Jesse, Tommy, and Joel.

guide.context: A challenge that does not explicitly name a character may progress while using another character; named objectives require the specified character.

steps.text: Unlock Dina, Jesse, Tommy, and Joel by completing the encounter totals shown in their preceding character tracks.
Open @mechanic{Challenges} and review every remaining objective under Ellie, Dina, Jesse, Tommy, and Joel.
Combine non-character-specific crafting, weapon, kill, and encounter goals during Custom Runs.
Use the explicitly named character for each restricted objective and continue until all five Ellie-line tracks display complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Abby faction challenge tracks
achievements.summary: Complete every No Return challenge track for Abby, Lev, Yara, Mel, and Manny.

guide.context: A challenge that does not explicitly name a character may progress while using another character; named objectives require the specified character.

steps.text: Unlock Lev, Yara, Mel, and Manny by completing the encounter totals shown in their preceding character tracks.
Open @mechanic{Challenges} and review every remaining objective under Abby, Lev, Yara, Mel, and Manny.
Combine non-character-specific healing, crafting, weapon, kill, and encounter goals during Custom Runs.
Use the explicitly named character for each restricted objective and continue until all five Abby-line tracks display complete.

achievements.description: Get an S rank on an encounter
achievements.summary: Earn an S rank after one No Return encounter by maximizing kills, speed, and survival.

guide.context: Board nodes with at least a 2.0x score multiplier are the most forgiving, and final bosses commonly award S ranks.

steps.text: Select a Very Light encounter whose board shows a score multiplier of @mechanic{2.0x or higher}.
Kill every enemy quickly with accurate shots while taking as little damage as possible.
Complete the encounter and remain on the results screen until the @mechanic{S rank} is displayed.

achievements.description: Win a Daily Run of No Return
achievements.estTime: one successful Daily Run after nine setup runs
achievements.summary: Unlock Daily Run after nine No Return runs, then win one complete online Daily Run including its boss.

guide.context: A Daily Run uses a fixed character and board shared by all players for 24 hours. A death normally consumes that day's only attempt.

steps.text: Start nine No Return runs; quick first-encounter deaths still advance @mechanic{Challenges > Core} until Daily Run unlocks.
Connect online, choose @mechanic{New Run > Daily Run}, and select Very Light difficulty.
Inspect the full board, choose low-risk encounters, and enter the final boss with full ammunition plus crafted explosives.
Finish every encounter and defeat the final boss without dying.

achievements.description: Win a Daily Run of No Return on Grounded difficulty
achievements.summary: Unlock Daily Run after nine No Return runs, then win one complete online Daily Run on Grounded.

guide.context: The Grounded preset is mandatory; Custom difficulty does not qualify. A death normally consumes the day's attempt, but eligible accessibility options remain enabled.

steps.text: Start nine No Return runs until @mechanic{New Run > Daily Run} becomes available.

Enable needed accessibility options, including High Contrast Display, reduced enemy accuracy, slow motion, or Invisible While Prone. At the Grounded warning that asks @mechanic{Reset these options?}, select @mechanic{No} to keep the enabled settings.
Connect online and start the Daily Run with the required @mechanic{Grounded} preset.
Choose the lowest-risk board path, stealth avoidable encounters, and conserve ammunition and explosives for the final boss.
Complete the entire Daily Run and defeat the boss without dying.

achievements.description: Complete the Part I challenge track in No Return
achievements.estTime: all Bill and Marlene Part I challenges
achievements.summary: Complete every current objective in No Return's Part I challenge track for Bill and Marlene.

guide.context: The added track arrived with Bill, Marlene, four new maps, and new achievements. Its live objective list is displayed in-game and may differ from older No Return references.

steps.text: From No Return, open @mechanic{Challenges > Part I} and read every objective currently listed for Bill and Marlene.
Play as @npc{Bill} when an objective names Bill and complete each displayed action until Bill's portion of the Part I track shows complete.
Play as @npc{Marlene} when an objective names Marlene and complete each displayed action until Marlene's portion of the Part I track shows complete.
Return to @mechanic{Challenges > Part I} and confirm that every objective in the track is marked complete.

achievements.description: Kill a Bloater with the pump shotgun as Bill in No Return
achievements.summary: As Bill in No Return, use Bill's custom Pump Shotgun to land the killing shot on a Bloater.

guide.context: Bill is stronger against melee attacks but cannot dodge; his custom Pump Shotgun is obtained from a dead drop.

steps.text: Select @npc{Bill} for a No Return run and choose a route capable of producing a @enemy{Bloater} encounter or boss.
Open a dead drop during the run and collect Bill's custom @item{Pump Shotgun}.
Damage the Bloater with other resources while reserving Pump Shotgun ammunition for the finishing attack.
Fire Bill's custom Pump Shotgun for the killing shot on the Bloater.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies with Marlene's assault rifle in one encounter in No Return
achievements.summary: As Marlene in No Return, kill 15 enemies with her Custom Assault Rifle during one encounter.

guide.context: Marlene's Risk Taker kit includes the required rifle, All or Nothing Gambits, and one path reroute per run.

steps.text: Select @npc{Marlene} and choose an encounter capable of spawning at least @mechanic{15 enemies}, such as a favorable Hunted node.
Enter the encounter with ample ammunition for Marlene's @item{Custom Assault Rifle} and avoid spending rifle rounds on non-killing damage.
Land the killing shot on 15 enemies with Marlene's Custom Assault Rifle before that single encounter ends.

achievements.displayName: I Would Do It All Over Again
achievements.description: Complete the story in chronological order
achievements.summary: Finish the complete story in the patched Chronological mode and reach its ending.

guide.context: Chronological mode was added in PC Patch 1.5. The reordered narrative is intended for returning players, so the original story order should be completed first.

steps.text: Install PC Patch 1.5 or later and confirm that @mechanic{Chronological} appears among the story options.
Choose Chronological mode and select any available difficulty.
Complete every reordered chapter and remain in the game until the Chronological ending finishes.
